features.title: Plush feel for timeless comfort
features.text: Sink into pure comfort with premium soft-touch fabric that feels gentle against the skin and offers a cozy, inviting feel for everyday lounging.

features.title: Comfort in every graceful curve
features.text: Designed for natural relaxation, the gently curved backrest provides the right support, making long conversations and movie nights even more enjoyable.

features.title: A strong edge with a soft touch
features.text: Crafted from rich sheesham wood, the sleek angular armrests add a stylish contrast to the plush upholstery while ensuring sturdy support for your arms.

features.title: Solid roots, unshakable charm
features.text: Built on a solid sheesham wood frame, this sofa stands the test of time—strong, durable, and made to be a part of your home for years.

features.title: Plush comfort that never fades
features.text: Experience superior comfort with Recron-filled cushions that maintain their shape, offering plush support and a snug seating experience every time.

features.title: No dust, no fuss, just ease
features.text: Raised legs make vacuuming or sweeping underneath effortless, helping you maintain a neat and tidy home.
